itemdesc-ingot-castiron*: High-carbon iron cast straight from the cupola. Hard and brittle - it cannot be forged, only melted and poured.
itemdesc-metalbit-castiron*: Chips of cast iron. Melt them down to recover the metal.
itemdesc-metalplate-castiron*: A plate cast in a mold rather than beaten on an anvil. The building block of low-pressure machinery.
itemdesc-rod-castiron*: A cast iron rod. Brittle stock for low-pressure machinery.
itemdesc-metalnailsandstrips-castiron*: Cast iron nails and strips. Brittle fixings for low-pressure work.
itemdesc-ingot-pigiron*: Crude high-carbon iron straight from the blast furnace, fit only for remelting or converting to steel.
itemdesc-slag*: A by-product tapped from the blast furnace.
itemdesc-powderedslag*: Ground slag, future mortar or fertilizer.
blockdesc-bunker-*: Stores prepared blast-furnace mix or crushed ore - one feedstock at a time. Built from any colour of fired brick (except fire and clinker), which sets its appearance.
iwex:bunker-help-add-stack: Add a stack (burden or crushed ore)
iwex:hoppertall-empty: Empty. Pour burden into the top.
blockdesc-mixer-*: Mechanically-driven mixer that blends crushed ore, flux and coke into blast-furnace burden. Drive the rotor with an axle on either side; the burden drains into the container below.
iwex:mixer-empty: Empty. Add crushed iron or scrap metal, lime and fuel (coke or charcoal).
iwex:mixer-drain-hint: Right-click the base to open the lids and drain into the container below.
iwex:mixer-help-add: Add one crushed iron / scrap / lime / coke / charcoal (or burden)
iwex:mixer-help-lid: Open or close the drain lids
designtable-desc-generic: Draft this plan onto parchment. Keep it as a reusable guide when crafting simple parts, or use it to plan a multiblock build.
blockdesc-blastfurnacecore*: The refractory hearth grate at the base of the cold blast furnace. Build the furnace up from it.
blockdesc-tuyere-tuyere*: A hot blast intake for the furnace shaft.
blockdesc-moltenmetaltap*: Drains the furnace's molten reservoir into a canal below.
blockdesc-cupolafurnacecore*: The refractory hearth grate at the base of the cupola furnace. Build the furnace up from it, then charge it with remelt burden through the tall hopper to re-melt scrap into cast iron.
blockdesc-hopper-tall*: Two blocks tall; charges the furnace shaft below it.
blockdesc-twintubmpblower*: Mechanically driven twin-tub bellows that supplies cold blast air.
blockdesc-slag*: A block of solidified slag from the blast furnace.
blockdesc-slagpath*: A sturdy road paved with crushed blast furnace slag.
blockdesc-solidifiediron*: Pig iron that cooled and hardened before it could be tapped or poured.
blockdesc-solidifiedcastiron*: Cast iron that froze in the cupola hearth before it could be tapped.
bf-info-heatstall: Needs {0} - add coke or hot blast
bf-info-wrongburden: Wrong burden: this shaft holds {0}, but this furnace burns {1}. {2} units will burn but not convert.
bf-info-airstarved: Starving for air - restore the blast!
bf-info-burnedout: Burden burned out - re-coke it in the mixer
bf-info-exhaustfull: Exhaust network is full! Production halted.
bf-info-needsmix: Blast Furnace needs more blast mix to fire!
bf-info-partiallylit: Piles are partially lit. Waiting for the fire to spread...
bf-info-ready: Blast Furnace is ready! Ignite the blast mix inside.
bf-error-incomplete: Structure is not complete. {0} blocks are missing or incorrect.
tap-err-nocanal: No canal start found below the tap!
itemdesc-burden: Prepared blast-furnace charge: iron ore, flux (limestone) and coke mixed in set proportions. Fed to the furnace through the reinforced hopper.
itemdesc-remeltburden: Prepared cupola charge: scrap iron, flux (limestone) and coke mixed in set proportions. Remelted in the cupola into cast iron.
iwex:burden-profile-offspec: Grade: off-spec (reload into mixer to adjust)
iwex:burden-profile-lowflux: Grade: off-spec - not enough flux (add limestone and remix)
iwex:burden-profile-burnedout: Grade: burned out (re-coke it in the mixer)
blockdesc-moltencanal-start*: The anchor of a molten canal network.
blockdesc-moltencanal-bend*: A 90° bend in a molten canal run.
blockdesc-moltencanal-tap*: Pours metal out of the far end of a canal.
blockdesc-moltencanal-moldpedestal*: Fills a mold it from the canal network.
blockdesc-moltenbarrel*: Bulk storage for liquid metal or slag.
game:ingameerror-iwex-moltenspill: The molten metal spilled out of the mold!
game:ingameerror-iwex-needemptyhands: The metal is still liquid! Take the mold with an empty hand.
game:ingameerror-iwex-moldtoosmall: This mold is used with the mold pedestal.
game:ingameerror-iwex-moldtoolarge: This mold will not fit on the pedestal.
game:ingameerror-iwex-canaltoohot: Wait for the metal to harden!
game:ingameerror-iwex-canalnotempty: Cannot seal while there is metal!
game:ingameerror-iwex-mixer-wronginput: The mixer only takes crushed iron, scrap metal, lime, coke or burden.
game:ingameerror-iwex-mixer-drainfirst: A finished batch is waiting - drain it before adding more.
game:ingameerror-iwex-mixer-wrongfamily: Iron ore and scrap metal make different burdens - do not mix them in one batch.
game:ingameerror-iwex-mixer-nothingmixed: Nothing is mixed yet - charge the mixer and drive the rotor first.
game:ingameerror-iwex-hoppertall-wronggr: The hopper already holds a different burden - empty it before adding another.
game:ingameerror-iwex-castingbed-toohot: Wait for the pig to harden before collecting it!
